WITH kind_filter AS (
    SELECT kt.id, kt.kind
    FROM kind_type AS kt
    WHERE kt.kind IN ('movie', 'tv movie', 'video movie', 'video game')
),
title_filter AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title, kf.kind
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN kind_filter AS kf ON kf.id = t.kind_id
    WHERE t.production_year > 1990
),
info_type_filter AS (
    SELECT it1.id
    FROM info_type AS it1
    WHERE it1.info = 'release dates'
),
release_info AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN info_type_filter AS it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE mi.note LIKE '%internet%'
      AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
      AND (mi.info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:% 200%')
),
us_company AS (
    SELECT cn.id
    FROM company_name AS cn
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
),
us_movie_companies AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM us_company AS cn
    JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.company_id = cn.id
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
),
verified_status AS (
    SELECT cct1.id
    FROM comp_cast_type AS cct1
    WHERE cct1.kind = 'complete+verified'
),
verified_complete_cast AS (
    SELECT cc.movie_id
    FROM complete_cast AS cc
    JOIN verified_status AS cct1 ON cct1.id = cc.status_id
),
keyword_movie AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
)
SELECT MIN(tf.kind) AS movie_kind,
       MIN(tf.title) AS complete_us_internet_movie
FROM title_filter AS tf
JOIN release_info AS ri ON ri.movie_id = tf.id
JOIN keyword_movie AS km ON km.movie_id = ri.movie_id
JOIN us_movie_companies AS umc ON umc.movie_id = ri.movie_id
JOIN verified_complete_cast AS vcc ON vcc.movie_id = ri.movie_id
